ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on the distal right lobe and the lateral left tip.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-contrast white patch on the upper-medial portion of the right lobe; complex, high-frequency white filigree and blotching on the lateral-most region of the left lobe; isolated white vertical linear streak near the ventral peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; notable large-scale irregular excision/indentation located on the distal trailing margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; left lobe exhibits a broad convex outer margin, while the right lobe shows a more vertically oriented, elongated convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of small, circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle scars) localized on the superior tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel, unaligned white linear rake marks concentrated on the far left fluke tip; single distinct vertical linear abrasion visible near the fluke center base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss/jagged indentation on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive white rake-mark scarring on the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific high-contrast 'scribble' pattern of white scars on the left lobe extremity combined with the unique jagged excision on the right lobe tip.
